comment: What the in-sandbox runner trims before running agent code. Windows Sandbox boots a fresh image every time, so host settings never carry over; this file is how Kris's stripped-down host choices get re-applied (search box, Task View and Cortana buttons hidden, as on the host) plus sandbox-only cuts. Edit freely: every switch is read at run time, nothing is compiled in. The runner logs process count and free memory before/after so each change can be measured.
kill_shell_comment: Stops explorer.exe (taskbar, desktop, news feed, tray apps) and keeps it from auto-restarting. Nothing the harness runs needs the shell; the status window works without it. Set false if you want to poke around the sandbox desktop.
defender_comment: defender_exclude_job skips scanning only the run folder and the read-only Godot folder (the files Godot touches). defender_realtime_off turns Defender's real-time scanning off for the whole disposable sandbox: faster boot-to-run on this spinning-disk machine, but it removes a layer of protection around agent-authored code, so it is opt-in. Neither setting touches the host.
